overview: A one-page Department of State list-of-papers or cross-reference sheet filed under “Manufacture of Metals—Japan.” It directs researchers to file 711.4215 Air Pollution/568g for a telegram from Switzerland, attributed to Harrison, reporting German press accounts of prospective Japanese research into the prospecting, smelting, and processing of rare minerals for war industries.

people.name: Harrison
people.role: Sender or reporting officer associated with the telegram from Switzerland

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to telegram on Japanese rare-mineral research
subfiles.about: The entry refers researchers to another file containing a report on prospective Japanese research into rare-mineral prospecting, smelting, and processing for war industries.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing sheet contains an entry for a telegram from Switzerland attributed to Harrison and dated December 2, with the year unstated. It cites German press reports that Japan planned special research into prospecting, smelting, and processing rare minerals for use in war industries. The underlying report was filed or cross-referenced under 711.4215 Air Pollution/568g rather than reproduced here.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a provenance and discovery aid: it reveals that intelligence concerning Japanese strategic-mineral research circulated through a diplomatic report from Switzerland and originated in German press coverage. Its unexpected cross-reference to an “Air Pollution” decimal-file heading also illustrates how State Department filing practices could disperse closely related industrial and wartime intelligence across seemingly unrelated subject files.
